Aditi: Legal emailed: they need auth + session logs "available for inspection" for 24 months. We currently do 90d raw + 1y redacted. Need a pragmatic pattern: where archive lives, KMS separation, JIT unseal, RBAC, and replay safeguards.

Ben: Proposal: move 90-730d into a 'sealed-vault' bucket (immutable objects) encrypted with HSM-backed CMK 'vault-cmk'. No routine raw access. Unsealing requires a ticket and a timeboxed unseal token.

Claire: Cost/ops notes: unsealing + replay can massively increase SIEM ingest & egress. Default replay throttle 250 ev/s per tenant, require SRE coordination for any request estimated to touch >2M events. Batch manifests for exports >5M.

Aditi: Access model sketch:
1) Request: /unseal-request --tenant=<t> --start=<d> --end=<d> --purpose="audit" -> creates ticket with uid
2) Triage: security ops validates scope (SLA 2 biz days)
3) Approval: "two-man rule" if >14 days contiguous or >500k events; otherwise single approver
4) On approval: mint ephemeral unseal token from unseal-service scoping to vault-cmk + manifest, TTL=4h, tied to ticket uid and approver ids
5) Delivery: either stream to SIEM with ingest throttles or produce presigned GETs (TTL=10m) for downloads
6) Audit: every action (request, approvals, token mint, decrypt calls, bytes delivered) written to immutable audit-bucket; evidence bundle hashed and retained for 7y
7) Token auto-revoked at expiry; any copies require separate ticket & justification

Ben: KMS policy idea: allow kms:Decrypt on vault-cmk only to principal 'unseal-service' when aws:RequestTag/ticket_id == <ticket> and only if request includes approved_by tag list. No long-lived creds for unsealers. Consider HSM "attestation" logs if available.

Claire: Implementation details:
- Presigned GET TTL 10m, logged to audit-bucket
- For >5M events: force manifest & staged batch export (max 1M events per batch)
- Prefer object-store server-side filters (S3 Select) for searches to avoid full decrypts
- All jobs require cost_center and ticket_id tags for chargeback and traceability

sre-oncall: Operational safeguards:
- Default replay throttle 250 ev/s/tenant; configurable via ops ticket
- Off-peak window required for large restores (22:00-06:00 UTC) unless approved otherwise
- Connector must honor 429 and implement exponential backoff + resume capability
- Monitor siem.ingest.error-rate and auto-pause if 5xx/429 > 3% over 5m

security-bot: TASK-12021 created: "Sealed-vault unseal workflow" assigned to Ben. (automated)

Aditi: RBAC proposal: roles 'vault_requester' (open unseal tickets + view redacted indices), 'vault_approver' (can approve), 'vault_unsealer' (execute unwraps after approval), 'redacted_analyst' (search-only). Grants for vault_unsealer require linked ticket, MFA, and recorded approver signature.

Ben: CLI examples:
```
/unseal-request --tenant=acme --start=2023-01-01 --end=2023-03-01 --purpose="regulatory review"
/unseal-approve REQ-12021 --approver=ben --mfa=true
```

Aditi: Audit record minimal schema (for evidence bundle): requestor, ticket_id, approvers, unseal_token_id, objects_touched, bytes_delivered, job_id, start_ts, end_ts, sha256_hashes. Store bundle to audit-bucket and generate immutable link.

Claire: Action items:

- Claire: runbook edits: replay throttles, staged export tests, and ingest backpressure simulation (due 2025-01-30)
- Aditi: update legal response & retention config (due 2025-02-05)
